approximations: mitsuba: absorption-only interior media use the `volpath` integrator (same max_depth and rr_depth rules as `path`); homogeneous medium with sigma_t = -ln(T)/depth per RGB channel (written as scale = max sigma and rgb = sigma / max sigma, because an `rgb` medium value must lie in [0, 1]), albedo 0.

mitsuba: participating media use `volpath` (max_depth = ours + 1); homogeneous media are written as scale x rgb (rgb must lie in [0, 1]); grids are `heterogeneous` media with a `.vol` gridvolume (grey sigma_t, trilinear, clamp outside: the scene keeps a zero border so it matches pbrt).
